reviews.text: I needed 2 windows replaced in my home and saw the great reviews of Mansfield Glass and gave them a call. They came out and measured and said the windows would be replaced in 2 weeks, but they had to send someone out with a taller ladder to reach the upper window. After they took the money for half the job and I didn’t hear back from them for almost a week, I called the office. They answered and seemed uniformed about the situation, but scheduled another visit with the taller ladder. The crew showed up and didn’t bring the taller ladder and said the office would schedule someone to come out. After some more time passed, I called the office and got the same type of response that they were going to send someone out. I expressed to them that I was trying to coordinate the solar screens getting installed on my windows. I had to give the screen installer and my HOA a timeline and it kept getting pushed back. Finally they came out and said 2 more weeks. After not hearing back from them in that time, I called back again. “Any day now,” they told me. The windows finally came in, but unfortunately one was broken and the other was the wrong size. This took way too long and communications from the office was horrible which caused this to drag out way longer than it needed to. The installers I delt with on several occasions were great and this is the only reason that I am giving Mansfield glass 3 stars and not something less. The office and communication deserves 1 star.
reviews.author: J

reviews.text: Mansfield Glass installed our windows several years ago. We recently had an issue due to operate error. They came to the rescue quickly and provided information for further reference. Thank you!
reviews.author: Barbara Gunderson

reviews.text: Mansfield Glass did an amazing job of replacing all of the windows in my two story house.  The crew replaced all of the windows in the time frame estimated.  I have worked in commercial construction for 30 years plus and I can vouch for the quality of work this team provides.

reviews.text:
Highly recommend.

reviews.text: I had two windows with hairline cracks in them. They were to come out and take measurements. The guy came out took measurements and broke one of my windows. He didn't say anything to my husband and I. I noticed it after he left. I called the company and spoke with the manager Shianne. She stated, they do that to bring back to the office. In order to see what type of glass it is. She agreed, he should have told us. There was no reason for it, especially since we hadn't hired them to do the work. It was for a quote. I asked her if they were going to cover the cost of the window. She said, "no we won't cover the cost, but I can send them out to board it up. They guys came and put the broken piece back along with waterproof tape on the window. I'm happy that was done, due to inclement weather. However, I'm not happy with the property damage, and them not taking accountability to fix the window.
reviews.author: Kimberly Morris

reviews.text: Excellent customer service, both in the office and from the people who did the work to repair the window glass in the house.  They are very punctual, they came between the time they had told me.  I highly recommend this company.

reviews.text: I worked in retail for over thirty years and have a well developed skill for customer service. When I purchased a home in Mansfield 8 years ago, I began using Mansfield glass for numerous needs over the years.They are consistent with doing the basics and go out of their way to take care of the customer. Several times they did not charge me and when they did, they always gave me a price and timeline before they did the work. They are a great organization!  Special shout out to Melissa, April and Chris among others. I can recommend them and will use Mansfield Glass again in the future!
reviews.author: Kevin Key

reviews.text: Good people & they go above and beyond with their customer service. We replaced all 36 windows on our property with this company in 2019. Fast forward to March 2025, the hail storm damaged 7 windows and the insurance was not allowing near enough for the replacement cost. Their superintendent, Jason Patterson, came on a non-business day on the weekend to meet with the adjuster to identify where the discrepancies were. Not because I asked, but because he wanted to help. It is very hard to find anyone that will go out of their way to help people anymore. I can't recommend them enough. The level of professionalism, workmanship, and customer care is superb. Give them a shot, you will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Leslie Lynch

reviews.text: We had two windows broken during the hail storm.  Mansfield Glass and windows did an amazing job replacing the glass for us.  It was a very simple process and everyone was so nice and accommodating.  The prices were very reasonable.  If I had known how easy it would be, I wouldn't have put it off like I did.  Highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Amanda U

reviews.text:
We recently replaced 8 windows in our 20 year old home.  I interviewed 4 companies, including two of the national brands.  The bids came back with a high of $26,630 and a low of $9,309- which was Mansfield Glass.  I would have gone with the second lowest company who were about $1,000 more, except that after asking friends and contractors who they recommend- it was Mansfield Glass- every time.  I'm very glad that we did.
The process was honest and straightforward from the start.  The salesman came out , measured, explained, took questions and gave us plenty of time to decide.  Upon paying a deposit and ordering the windows, until they were delivered, there wasn't any time that we felt left out of the process.  The windows were installed last week and they are exactly what we wanted, were installed with precision, and the install team took very good care of our home. They couldn't have been nicer or easier to work with.
The warranty is clearly spelled out in writing, but I doubt if I'll ever have to use it.  I'm very pleased with our purchase.
reviews.author: Larry Nix

reviews.text: We are very pleased with the fast friendly service we received. I’d recommend Mansfield Glass to anyone opposed to any others!!

There was no charge for this extra service.   They definitely take good care of their customers!

reviews.text:
Estimator/technician came to check and take the measurements for a living room window we needed replaced that was costing us almost $1000. We had to pay and schedule another contractor just to remove and reinstall a pergola obstructing this window. So basically a complicated and timely operation for us.

The technician told us that “as soon as” they receive the glass, they will have it installed. First It took 10 working days for the glass to arrive, which was within the tail end of the 5-10 days we were promised.. which we had to live with. Next when we called to inquire about the glass installation, we were told we had to wait another week to get it installed, which was news to us!!  We were very unhappy about that part and asked the front desk person to connect us with either with the manager or owner so we could complain and come to a resolution. She said no one was available at their desks.. didn’t offer either to have anyone call us back and sort things out.  We then decided to place this 1-star initial review to get the owner or manager’s attention.

Almost immediately we got a callback from the manager and apologized... which was nice. We suggested that they simply refrain their technicians from giving out unrealistic timelines and it would solve these problems.  And then the owner left a voicemail and emailed us. The tone was very direct not apologetic - offering us a deposit refund (as we had mentioned that in our initial review).

We replied back nicely saying it was all about expectations, and we were not complaining to get discounts or free stuff! We are not like that. We simply needed our window fixed in a timely fashion. Had we felt a nicer approach was taken to retain our business, we would have changed or removed our initial review into something positive; it’s all about service.

In turn we were told that we were trying to indirectly blackmail them with a bad google review to get in front of the installation line!! Really?! Not sure how that conclusion was made.

At that point we were DONE! We decided to take a full refund and not deal with them again. To make things worst we have emails showing how they googled our personal Business ownership information and referenced it in writing - completely irrelevant and inappropriate!  Unbelievable.  We were also told that they would be ready to fire back a review response as soon as we modified this review.

These are the facts. Choose wisely.
